scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy: Physically Handicapped Persons/ Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: The unit must be a new industrial unit that started production on or after 5th August 2009.
Physically handicapped entrepreneurs must have at least 40% disability as per the relevant category.
Applicable only to micro and small manufacturing enterprises.
Eligibility category noted in source: Physically Handicapped
Eligibility category noted in source: Ex-Servicemen
benefits_summary: Provides a capital investment subsidy of 25% up to ₹2,500,000 for eligible new micro and small manufacturing enterprises.
